exposure: Yixin Da cervical double-lumen balloon dilatation combined with low-dose oxytocin
cohort: The study analyzed 100 full-term labor induction cases at Beijing Luhe Hospital Affiliated to Capital Medical University between January 2022 and December 2023.
finding: The combination of the Yixin Da balloon with low-dose oxytocin significantly enhances cervical ripening, shortens labor duration, reduces complications, and improves patient satisfaction compared to low-dose oxytocin alone.
